root_idea.summary: The root is oriented around youthful inclination: turning or yearning toward something, with related associations of youth and childish conduct.
root_idea.development: The lexical evidence extends this orientation from yearning and youthful behavior to physical leaning, lowering or inversion, causative attraction, and the east wind. These developments describe the root's semantic range rather than the meaning of every derived form.

senses.definition: To incline or yearn toward someone or something.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic imperfect form occurs with إِلَى in a context where such inclination is associated with the possibility of youthful or ignorant conduct; the lexical core is turning or yearning toward the object.

senses.definition: A child who has not reached puberty; a young child or youth.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrences refer to a male child, while the broader lexical evidence also records wider use of the word.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become youthful; to behave with the folly, silliness, or ignorance associated with youth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a Classical use of the verb and is distinct from merely inclining or yearning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To show passionate love or desire, or to indulge in amorous dalliance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Recorded especially in connection with the infinitives صِبًا and صَبَاءٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incline or lean, said of a palm tree turning toward a distant male palm.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use describing natural inclination between palm trees.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incline the head toward the pasture, said of a grazing animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is the animal's own head, lowered onto the pasture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To blow, said of the east wind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb is used of the wind called الصَّبَا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incline or lower the head toward the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II construction with the head as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incline or lower the head of a spear in preparation for piercing or thrusting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The spear is directed downward or otherwise positioned for use in thrusting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a sword or knife into its case or sheath reversed or improperly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction describes placing the implement with its orientation reversed or not in the proper manner.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a building or a person incline, lean, or be overturned.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The use is causative and applies both to a structure and, in a reported use, to an old man.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To invert the lips while drinking, said of a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal-behavior construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To recite a verse incorrectly or make speech deviate from its proper course.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The use concerns defective meter, recitation, or expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn away from a type of pasture or vegetation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Recorded in the phrase صَابَيْنَا عَنِ الحَمْضِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a reported phrase, for girls or young women to look out from behind a curtain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The wording and preposition are noted as possibly affected by transcription; the lexical interpretation is therefore reported cautiously.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bear or give birth to a child.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV use said of a woman who has a child, male or female.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To excite or invite another's desire, make another incline toward youthful or foolish conduct, or beguile and captivate the heart.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The use is causative; it can describe attempting to draw another person's spouse toward oneself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter a period in which the east wind is blowing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV use connected with the wind called الصَّبَا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To behave childishly or impudently, or to pass for a child.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These meanings are attributed to later authorities, and the usage is described as apparently post-Classical.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The east wind, or an easterly wind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It is variously described by its direction from sunrise and by traditional regional wind bearings; it is also associated with a gentle, pleasant gale.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Youth, boyhood, or childhood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It denotes the state or period of being a صَبِيّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Youthful folly or silliness, including amorous dalliance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a derived use distinct from the basic designation of the period of childhood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A young woman, girl, or female child.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This wider use is explicitly recorded in the Classical lexical evidence alongside the more usual male-child use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A condition of flatulence or wind affecting children.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed expression; other later explanations of the expression are also reported in the lexical tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The pupil of the eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is marked as a figurative or assumed-tropical use and is attributed by one authority to vulgar usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The extremities or outward-curving edges of the two jaw-bones, especially those of an animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical plural expression with variant descriptions of the precise portion intended.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The bone below the lobe of each ear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical use with a more specific description identifying the head of that bone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The edge or central ridge of a sword, and likewise of a spearhead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or assumed-tropical extension to a weapon's projecting edge or ridge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The head or upper part of the human foot, between the instep region and the toes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical use; the source corrects a transmitted wording concerning the foot.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two sides of a camel's saddle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized assumed-tropical plural expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In disputed expressions, grains of hoarfrost resembling pearls or small drops of rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The attribution is explicitly contested: another authority reads the word as صِئْبَان, from a different form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who indulges in youthful folly or amorous dalliance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived nominal describing a person characterized by صَبْوَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: People who incline toward conflicts, factions, seditions, or similar disturbances and like to be foremost in them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural expression derived from صَابٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An oblique wind blowing between the east and the north.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It is described as cold and boisterous and as lacking rain or beneficial effect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having children or a child.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to a woman, and also recorded for a man.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Metaphorically, wine whose sealed covering has been broken.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of the feminine derived form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A calamity or misfortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct derived nominal meaning.

cautions: The Quranic verb form أَصْبُ is presented under the normalized Form I citation headword صَبَا.
A Lane and Mufradat discussion of الصَّابِئُونَ and reported readings such as الصَّابِينَ is not assigned to a supplied Quranic form here because its derivation from صبو versus صبأ is not secure.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: lane:entry:25361 contains a reported Quranic variant-reading and lexical attribution involving الصَّابِينَ/الصَّابِيُونَ; the evidence does not securely establish that this material belongs to the صبو root rather than the صبأ root, and no corresponding QAC form group is supplied.

mufradat:row:810 discusses الصَّابِئُونَ and the possible derivation of reported الصَّابِينَ readings from صَبَا; this cross-root and variant-reading issue is preserved but is not presented as a Quranic sense of either supplied QAC form.
